description: Na₃MoF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to twelve equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent MoF₆ octahedra. All Na-F bond lengths are 3.01 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.19 Å. Mo is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form MoF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Mo-F bond lengths are 2.06 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to five Na and one Mo atom.
